subject: RRO 3.2.2 Windows installation not detected in registry

messages.author: c0c9e1e5e48ee824
messages.subject: RRO 3.2.2 Windows installation not detected in registry
parts:
Hi all,

I tried to install RRO along with the Microsoft R Server developer edition. The installation of RRO 3.2.2 works without any problems, but the RRE installer complains that RRO 3.2.2 could not be found in the registry. During the RRO installation, the 'Save version number in registry' option was ticked. Note that the same problem occurs when trying to install the Intel MKL libraries on top of RRO 3.2.2.

Is anyone else experiencing this problem?

Thanks a lot and best regards
Eike

messages.author: 9ca0345d553844f2
messages.subject: Re: RRO 3.2.2 Windows installation not detected in registry
parts:
Hi Eike,

The version you want for use with Microsoft R Server is MRO for MRS. Download it here: https://mran.revolutionanalytics.com/download/mro-for-mrs/

Thanks,
Josée
